reviews.title: Great for 1440p gaming
reviews.comment: This card is great for 1440p gaming. I have not tried 4K gaming as my monitors are only 1440p. The cooler on the card keeps the card from going above 65 degrees Celsius when gaming. When the card is idle, it stays 30-40 degrees Celsius (I also have 3 intake case fans right below the card. I also like the ARGB lighting. It looks even better if you mount the card vertically (even though mine is horizontal). It also does not use an insane amount of power like the bigger cards do and is more than small enough to fit in my case. This is a high quality card for the money if you can get it on sale.

reviews.author: Jp

reviews.title: Great upgrade so far
reviews.comment: Card is running all recent games with no issues and at max settings. Even at peak usage card fans are super quiet compared to my old rtx 2080 which sounded like a jet taking off. Price I got it at was very reasonable compared to seeing 3060 cards at the same cost. 16gb is a good amount of vram, but I'm seeing alot of these games running at the 12-14gb range so this might become minimum for high end gaming, hopefully the new AI tech in the cards can compensate well with the lower vram cards. Heads up if your upgrading your rig, you need a minimum 600w power supply to run the card.
reviews.author: Edan

reviews.title: Best card on the market (16gb)
reviews.comment: Why did you pick this product vs others?: 16GB puts this graphics card (1.7x faster than my 2070fe) in a whole new category of cards. Paired with a i9-9900k it plays EVERYTHING at max. Running on pcie3.0 even! Make sure to uninstall your current drivers then plug the card in or you’ll be pulling it out again. Don’t buy 8gb, not worth the price. Get the 16gb. Fans are quiet too (3fan model) lights are programmable as well.  Now for a modular power source…
reviews.author: Evan

reviews.title: Great 2k card, decent 4k with 2x frame gen
reviews.comment: After about 6 months of owning this gpu I would say that for the price it’s not terrible this is recommended as a 2k card I would for the most part agree, at least for competitive titles like call of duty or battlefield. Now if you play story based games this card will run 4k decently with frame gen 2x I personally would not recommend higher. I upgraded from a 12gb 3060 and the increase was noticeable but not what I expected for 2 series newer gpu with 4gb more vram
